verdict.label: Steady market
verdict.headline: Card prices are steady: no strong move either way right now.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 104.2 (+0.5% in a day) and momentum is 53: prices are steady. 84s cost 700, 85s 2,400 and 86s 5,000. Midweek is usually the quietest time to buy cards for the weekend.

moves.title: Buy Tabitha Chawinga 87 for the weekend, sell by Friday evening
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 12,000 coins. Now 12,500. Buy before the weekend: meta cards are bought for Champions weekend, so they often rise from midweek to Friday evening. Picked because it is meta rating 91 at ST for 12,000 coins. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 0 of 2 so far, averaging -19.1% after tax. It sells and buys back, so the 5% tax is counted.

moves.title: Quiet midweek: plan your weekend squad now
moves.detail: Midweek is usually the cheapest time to buy cards you will play at the weekend. The next Rivals rewards come {{t:2026-10-22T07:59:00+01:00}} and add fodder supply.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 700 (0.84 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,400 (1.14 coins per Item Score point), 86s 5,000 (1.22 coins per Item Score point), 87s 7,000 (1.27 coins per Item Score point), 88s 11,500 (1.39 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Julia Zigiotti and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Julia Zigiotti 78 Rare -68.8%; Lothar Matthäus 90 Base Icon -27.6%; Garrincha 93 Base Icon -20.6%; Bradley Barcola 85 Rare -16.4%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
